name: Chichi
source:
Born as a variant of her race, Chichi the Scylla bears the distinct markings of a blue ringed octopus and has faced discrimination at her own hands, and the hands of others. 

[Edited from [url=https://chasecubed.itch.io/head-over-heels]Itch.io[/url]]
